Gallego calls for AI regulation | Nightly Roundup
 By FOX 10 Staff Nightly Roundup Published  October 20, 2026 6:20 PM MST Published  October 20, 2026 6:20 PM MST PHOENIX - From storm preparations across Arizona, to curfews in Paris, and a wastewater pipe burst, here's a look at your top stories and videos on FOX 10 for Tuesday, October 20, 2026. 
 1. Preparing for storms across Arizona
 Featured
 article Arizona flood watch: Crews prepare as incoming storms bring hail and rain risk 
 Public works crews across Arizona are prepping washes, clearing canals, and setting up sandbag stations as the National Weather Service issues statewide flood watches ahead of forecasted rain.
 2. Paris enacts nightly curfews after violent rioting and looting
 3. Fans caught in raceway splash zone
 Featured
 article Phoenix Raceway wastewater pipe burst drenches fans before NASCAR event 
 Several fans at Phoenix Raceway were caught in a wastewater splash zone after a suite pipe burst on Oct. 18. Staff repaired the pipe, sanitized the area, and prepared for Sunday's NASCAR event.
 4. Sen. Ruben Gallego calls for committee to urgently regulate AI
 5. Man sentenced after targeting unhoused people, killing one
 Featured
 article Phoenix hammer killer gets 30 years for bludgeoning sleeping homeless men 
 Mahrion Mendonca was sentenced to 30 years in prison for deadly, unprovoked hammer attacks on sleeping homeless people in downtown Phoenix.
